data.titulo: Nqi tseg Babulon kom mus rau kav cov ntsem khiab Jerusalem
data.contenido:
Babulon-a saltan chhungin, Israel-mite chuan an rinna fiahna tam tak an tawk a. Shadraka, Meshaka leh Abednegoa te chu rawhtuina mei alha paih luh an ni a, mahse Pathianin a nungin a hruai chhuak a. A hnuah, Babulon chu Media leh Persia-in an hneh hnuah, Daniela chu sakeibaknei pukah thlak a ni a, mahse sakeibakneite ka tichipin Pathianin amah a hum bawk a.

A tawpah, Persia lai Kuran Israel-mite a chhuahtir a. Saltanga Babulon-a kal bopui an nih hnu kum 70 chiahah anmahni ramah an kir leh a. Jerusalem-a +an kir laia thil an tih zinga hmasa ber pakhat chu Jehova biak in sak tan a ni. Amaherawhchu, hmelmaten hnathawh an titawp thuai a. Tichuan Jerusalem-a an kir hnu kum 22 velah chauh, biak in chu sak zawh a ni.

Chumi dawtah chuan, biak in cheimawi tura Jerusalem-a Ezra zin hnu kum 13-ah Nehemian Jerusalem kulh chim chu a sak thatpuia. Bung NGA hian chumi thlenga kum 152 chhung chanchin a huap a ni.

HENG tlangval pathumte chanchin i hriat i la hrereng em? Aw, an tana tha lo ei duh lotu Daniela thiante kha an ni. Babulon-mite chuan Shadraka, Meshaka leh Abednegoa an vuah a. Mahse tunah han en teh. Engvanginnge mi dang ang bawka he milem lian pui hnenah hian an kun ve loh? I hmu chhuak ang u.

Amah Jehova ngeiin a ziak Thusawm an vuah dante kha i la hrereng em? Chumia pakhat chu: ‘Keimah chauh lo chu pathian dang engmah i be tur a ni lo,’ tih hi a ni. Heta tlangvalte hian, thil tih awlsam a ni lo chungin, chu dan chu an zawm a ni.

Babulon lalber Nebukadnezzara chuan he milim a siam hi chawimawi turin mi pawimawh tam tak a ko va. Mi zawng zawng hnenah: ‘Tawtawrawtte, tingtangte leh tumrikna hmanraw dangte ri in hriat hunah, kuna he rangkachak milim hi be tur in ni. Tupawh kuna be lo apiang chu rawhtuina mei alh saah paih luh nghal a ni ang,’ tiin a sawi zo hlim hlawl a ni a.

Nebukadnezzaran Shadraka, Meshaka leh Abednegoa te an kun lo tih a hriatin a thinrim em em a. A hnenah a hruaitir a. Kunna tur remchang dang a pe a. Mahse tlangvalte chuan Jehova an ring a. ‘A rawng kan bawl kan Pathian chuan min chhandam thei a. Mahse min chhandam loh pawhin, i rangkachak milim hnenah kan kun lo vang,’ tiin Nebukadnezzara chu an hrilh a.

Chu chu a hriatin Nebukadnezzara chu a thinrim lehzual a. A kiang hnaiah rawhtuina mei a awm a: ‘Rawhtuina mei kha a hma aia a let sariha sa zawkin tisa rawh u!’ tiin thu a pe a. Tichuan a sipai ruala chak berte chu Shadraka, Meshaka leh Abednegoa te chu a phuartir a, rawhtuinaah a paih luhtir a. Rawhtuina chu a sa khawp a, mi chakte chu meialhin a tihlum a. Mahse an paih luh mi pathumte chu engtinnge an awm?

Lalber chuan rawhtuina chu a en a, a hlau ta em em a. ‘Mi pathum phuarin rawhtuina meialh saah kan paih lut a ni lawm ni?’ tiin a zawt a.

‘Aw, kan paih luh kha,’ tiin chhiahhlawhten an chhang a.

‘Mahse meia kal vel mi pali ka hmu. Phuar an ni lo va, meiin anmahni a tina lo. Tin palina chu pathian angin a Jang,’ a ti a. Lalber chu rawhtuina kawngka hnaiah a kal a, ‘Shadrak! Meshak! Abednego! nangni Pathian Chungnungbera chhiahhlawhte u, lo chhuak rawh u,’ tiin a au chhuak a.

An lo chhuah chuan, tihnat an nih lohzia mi tinin an hmu thei a. Tin lalber chuan: ‘Shadraka, Meshaka leh Abednegoa te Pathian chu fakin awm rawh se! Anmahni Pathian chauh lo chu eng pathian mah biaa an kun dawn loh vangin a vantirhkoh a tir a, anmahni a chhandam ta,’ a ti a.

Hei hi Jehova laka rinawmnaa kan entawn tur tha a a ni.Exodus 20:3; Daniela 3:1-30. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HETAH hian enge lo awm? Mipui hian ruai ropui tak an theh a. Babulon lalber chuan mikhual pawimawh sang khat a sawm a. Jerusalem-a Jehova biak in atanga lak rangkachak leh tangkaraw no leh thleng kumte an hmang a. Mahse, thawk leh khatah, boruakah mipa kutzungtangte a lo lang a, bangah chuan a ziak a. Mi tinin an hlau va.

Tunah Belshazara, Nebukadnezzara tupa chu lalber a ni a. A mi fingte rawn hruai turin a au va. ‘Tupawh he ziak hi chhiar a, a awmzia mi hrilh apiang thilpek tam tak pek leh he rama roreltu pawimawh ber pathumnaa siam a ni ang,’ lalber chuan a ti a. Mahse mi fiang pakhat mahin banga ziak chu an chhiarin a awmzia an sawi thei lo va.

Lalber nu chuan ri chu a hria a, chaw eina pindan zau puiah chuan a lo lut a. ‘Khawngaih takin chuti em chuan hlau suh u. I ramah hian pathian thianghlimte hretu mi pakhat a awm a. I pu Nebukadnezzara lalber a nih lai chuan a mi fingte zawng zawng chunga hotuah a siam a. A hming chu Daniela a ni. Amah chu kohtir la, heng zawng zawng awmzia hi a hrilh ang che,’ a ti a.

Tin Daniela chu an rawn hruai nghal a. Thilpek engmah a lak duh loh hnuah, Daniela chuan Belshazzara pu Nebukadnezzara chu lalber nihna atanga Jehovan vawi khata a hnawlna chhan a hrilh ta a. ‘A chapo em em a. Tin Jehovan amah a hrem ta a ni,’ Danielan a ti a.

Mahse nangin a chunga thil thleng chanchin i hre vek a, tin Nebukadnezzara ang chiahin i la chapo va. Jehova biak in atangin note leh thlengkumte i la a, zu in nan i hmang a. Thing leh lunga siam pathiante i fak a, min Siamtu Ropui i chawimawi lo va. Chuvang chuan heng thute hi ziak turin Pathianin kut chu a tir a ni,’ tiin Danielan Belshazzara a hrilh a. Danielan: ‘Ziak chu hei hi a ni: MENE, MENE, TEKEL leh PARSIN.’

‘MENE awmzia chu i ram nite chu Pathianin a chhiar tawh a, a titawp tawh. TEKEL chu buknaa buk i ni tawh a, tha lova hmuh i ni tawh tihna. PARSIN chu i ram chu Media leh Persia-mite hnena pek a ni tawh tihna a ni,’ a ti a.

Danielan a sawi lai mek chuan, Media leh Persia-mite chuan Babulon an bei tan tawh a. Khawpui chu an man a, Belshazzara an tihlum a. Chumi zan ngei chuan banga kutziak chu a thleng dik ta a! Mahse tunah Israel-mite chungah enge thleng ang? Kan hmu chhuakthuai ang a, mahse Daniela chungah enge thleng i en hmasa ang u.Daniela 5:1-31. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

AW, AW! Danielan buaina ngahin a lang. Mahse sakeibakneite chuan amah an tina lo! Engvanginnge i hria em? Tuinnge Daniela chu hetah heng sakeibaknei zawng zawng nen hian dah? I hmu chhuak ang u.

Tunah chuan Babulon lalber chu a hming Daria a ni tawh a. Daniela chu a fing a, ngil a neih vangin Daniela a duh em em a. Daria chuan Daniela chu roreltu hotu ni turin a thlang a. Chu chuan lalrama mi dangte chu a thiktir a, chuvangin hei hi an ti ta a ni.

Daria hnenah an kal a: ‘Aw lalber, ni 30 chhungin i hnenah chauh lo chuan mihring emaw pathian emaw hnenah tumah an tawngtai tur a ni lo tih dan i siam tur a ni tih kan remti tlang a, Aw lalber. Tupawhin a zawm loh chuan, sakeibakneite hnenah paih luh tur a ni,’ an ti a. Chung mite chuan chu dan chu eng vangin nge siam an duh tih Darian a hre lo. Mahse thain a hria a, tichuan dan chu ziakin a dah ta a.

Dan chungchang chu Danielan a hriatin, inah a haw a, a tih thin ang bawkin a tawngtai a. Danielan Jehova hnena a tawngtai a bang lovang tih mi tha lote chuan an hria a. Daniela tihbona tura an remruat chu hlawhtling dawna a Jan vangin an hlim hle a.

Chung miten chu dan an duhna chhan Lalber Darian a hriatin, a lungngai em em a. Mahse dan chu a thlak thei si lo va, chuvangin sakeibaknei puka Daniela paih luh thu a pe tur a ni. Mahse lalber chuan Daniela chu: ‘A rawng i bawl i Pathianin a chhandam che ka beisei e,’ tiin a hrilh a. Daria chu a mangang khawpa, chumi zan chuan a muhil thei lo va. A tuk zingah chuan sakeibaknei pukah a tlan a. Sawta saw amah i hmu thei a. ‘Pathian nung chhiahhlawh Daniel! A rawng i bawl Pathianin sakeibaknei lakah a chhandam thei che em?’ tiin a au chhuak a.

‘Pathianin a vantirhkoh a tir a, min tihnat loh nan sakeibaknei kate a tichip a,’ tiin Danielan a chhang a.

Lalber chu a lawm em em a. Puk ata Daniela khai chhuak turin thu a pe a. Tin Daniela tihbo tumtu mi tha lote chu sakeibaknei pukah a paih a. Puk chhuat an thlen hmain sakeibakneiten an man a, an ruhte an tikeh sawm vek a.

Tin Lalber Daria chuan a rama mipui zawng zawng hnenah: ‘Mi tinin Daniela Pathian an zah tur a ni tih thu ka pe e. Thilmak ropui tak a ti a. Sakeibaknei ei loh turin Daniela a chhandam,’ tiin lehkha a thawn a.Daniela 6:1-28. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

MEDIA leh Persia-miten Babulon an lak achin kum hnih a ral lek lek tawh a. Tunah enge thleng han en teh! A ni, Israel-miten Babulon an chhuahsan mek a ni. Engtinnge an chhuah? Tuinnge kaltir?

Persia lalber Kuran a kaltir a ni. Kura pian hma daihah a chanchin Jehovan a zawlnei Isaia a ziahtir a. ‘Ti tura ka duh che ngei chu i ti ang. Khawpui i lak nan kawngkate chu hawnsaa dah an ni ang,’ tiin. Babulon laknaah Kuran hma a hruai a. Media leh Persia-mite chu zanah kawngka hawn saah khawpui an lut ta a ni.

Mahse Jehova zawlnei Isaia chuan Jerusalem leh a biak in sa leh turin Kuran thu a pe ang a ti bawk a. Chu thupek chu Kuran a pe em? Aw, pe e. Kuran Israel-mite a hrilh chu hei hi a ni: ‘Tunah Jerusalem-ah kal ula, tin in Pathian Jehova biak in sa rawh u,’ tih hi. Chu ngei chu ti turin heng Israel-mite hi an kal mek a ni.

Mahse Babulon-a Israel mi zawng zawngin Jerusalem-a haw kawng hla tak chu an kal thei lo va. Zin kawng thui deuh mel 500 (kilometer 800) vel a ni a, tin tam tak chu chuti anga hla zin tur chuan an tar lutuk emaw an dam lo lutuk emaw a ni. Tin mi thenkhat kal lohna chhan dang pawh a awm. Mahse kal lote chu Kuran: ‘Jerusalem leh a biak in sa tura kalte hnenah tangkarua leh rangkachak leh thilpek dangte pe rawh u,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Tichuan, Jerusalem-a haw Israel-mite chu thilpek tam deuh pek an ni a. Kura chuan Lalber Nebukadnezzaran Jerusalem a tichhiat laia a lak thlengkumte leh note chu an hnenah a pe a. Mipuite chuan ken haw tur an ngah ngawt mai.

Thla li vel an thang hnuah, Israel-mite chuan a hun takah Jerusalem an thleng a. Khawpui tihchhiat a nih leh ram chu a ruak veka hnutchhiah a nih achin kum 70 chiah a ni. Israel-mite chu anmahni ramah an kir leh tawh na a, kan hriat leh tur angin hun harsa thenkhat an nei dawn.Isaia 44:28; 45:1-4; Ezra 1:1-11. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

MI 50,000 deuhthaw Babulon atanga Jerusalem zin kawng thui takah chuan an kal a. Mahse an thlen chuan, Jerusalem chu khawram lian pui ringawt a ni. Tumah cheng an awm lo. Israel-mite chuan engkim an din that leh vek a ngai a.

An sak hmasak ber zinga pakhat chu maicham a ni. Chu chu Jehova hnena thilpek emaw ran hlanna emaw an siamna hmun chu a ni. Thla tlemte hnuah Israel-mite chuan biak in an sa tan a. Mahse a kiang hnai rama cheng hmelmate chuan Israel-mite chu sa leh turin an duh lo va. Chuvangin tawptir turin an tihthaih a. A tawpah, chung hmelmate chuan Persia lalber thar chu in sak tawptir turin dan an siamtir a.

Kumte an ral a. Tunah chuan Babulon atanga Israel-mite lo kir achin kum 17 a ni tawh a. In sa tan leh tura a mipuite hrilh turin Jehovan a zawlnei Haggaia leh Zekaria a tir a. Mipuite chuan Pathian tanpuina an ring a, zawlneite thu chu an awih

a. Dan chuan sa tur an ni lo a ti chungin an sa tan leh a. Tichuan sorkar hnathawk Persia-mi a hming Tattenaia a lo kal a, Israel-mite chu biak in sak theihna enge an neih a zawt

a. Israel-mite chuan Babulon-a an awm laiin, Lalber Kuran: ‘Tunah Jerusalemah kal ula, in Pathian Jehova biak in han sa rawh u,‘ tiin anmahni a hrilh tih an hrilh a. Tattenaia chuan Babulon-ah lehkha a thawn a, chu tih laia thi tawh Kura chuan a sawi tak tak em tih a zawt a. Persia lalber thar hnen atangin lehkhathawn a lo thleng thuai a. Kuran a sawi tak tak tih a hrilh a. Tin lalber chuan: ‘Israel-mite chuan an Pathian biak in sa rawh se. Tin anmahni tanpui turin thu ka pe a che,‘ tiin a ziak bawk a. Kum li velah biak in chu sak zawh a ni a, Israel-mite chu an hlim em em a.

Kum tam tak a ral leh a. Tunah chuan biak in sak zawh achin kum 48 a ni thelh tawh. Jerusalem-a mipui an rethei a, khawpui leh Pathian biak in chu an lang mawi vak lo va.

Babulon-ah, Israel-mi Ezra chuan Pathian biak in chei that a ngaihzia chungchang a hria a. Tichuan enge a tih i hria em?

Ezra chu Persia lai Artazerzia hmu turin a ka! a. Tin chu lai tha chuan Jerusalem-a hawpui tur thilpek tam tak Ezra a pe a. Ezra chuan Babulon-a Israel-mite chu Jerusalem-a chung thilpekte kenpui turin a ngen a. Mi 6,000 velin ka! an tum a. Ken tur tangkarua leh rangkachak leh thil hlu dang an ngah em em a.

Kawngah mi tha lote an awm avangin Ezran a lungkham a. Chung mite chuan an tangkarua leh rangkachak te chu lak sakin anmahni an tihlum thei a. Chuvangin Ezra chuan, milema i hmuh ang hian, mipui a ko khawm a. Jerusalem-a haw kawng thui taka anmahni humhim turin Jehova hnenah an tawngtai a ni.

Jehovan anmahni a humhim a. Tin thla li an zin hnuah, him takin Jerusalem an thleng a. Hei hian tanpui tura amah ringtute chu Jehovan a humhim thei tih a tilang lawm ni?Ezra bung 2 aṭanga 8. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

JERUSALEM-a Ezra kal hma kum tlem teah kir leh ila. Mordekaia leh Estheri chu Persia rama Israel-mi pawimawh ber an ni. Estheri chu lalnu a ni a, tin a pa unau Mordekaia chu thuneihnaah lalber dawttu a ni. Hei hi engtinnge a lo nih i en ang u.

Estheri chu a la tet em em laiin a nu leh pa an thi a, tichuan Mordekaian a chawm lian a. Persia lalber Ahasueran Shushan khawpuiah lal in a nei a, Mordekaia chu a chhiahhlawhte zinga pakhat a ni a. Ni khat chu lalber nupui Vashti chuan a thu a awih lo va, tichuan lalber chuan lalnu ni turin nupui thar a thlang a. A thlan hmeichhia chu i hria em? Aw, nula hmeltha Estheri a ni. He miten kuna chibai an buk mi chapo hi i hria em? Hei hi Hamana a ni. Persia-ah mi pawimawh em em a ni. Hamana chuan heta thua i hmuh Mordekaia pawh hi a hmaa kun ve turin a duh a. Mahse Mordekaia chu a kun dawn lo. Chutiang mi tha lo hmaa kun chu dikin a hre lo. Chu chuan Hamana a tithinrim em em a. Chuvangin hetiang hian a ti a.

Hamana chuan Israel-mite chungchang dawtthu lalber a hrilh a. ‘I dan zawm lotu mi tha loho an ni. Tihhlum tur an ni,’ tiin. Ahasuera chuan a nupui Estheri chu Israel-mi a nih a hre lo va. Tichuan Hamana thu a ngaihthla a, eng niah emaw Israel-mite zawng zawng tihhlum tur tih dan a siam ta a.

Mordekaian dan chungchang chu a hriatin a mangang em em a. Estheri hnenah thu a chah a: ‘Lalber hnenah min chhandam turin ngen rawh,’ tiin. Sawm i nih loh chuan lalber hnena kala va hmuh chu Persia-ah dan a ni lo va. Mahse sawm lohvin Estheri chu a lut a. Lalber chuan a rangkachak tiang a lamah a lek a, chu chu tihhlum loh tur tihna a ni. Estherin lalber leh Hamana chu ruai ropui takah a sawm a. Chutah chuan lalber chuan Estherin a lakah duhsakna enge a duh a zawt a. Estheri chuan a tukah ruai danga amah leh Hamana an lo kal chuan a hrilh ang tih a sawi a.

Chu ruaiah chuan Estherin lalber chu a hrilh a: ‘Keimah leh ka mite tihhlum tur kan ni,’ tiin. Lalber thin a ur a. ‘Tunge chutiang thil chu ti ngam?’ tiin a zawt a.

Chu pa, hmelma chu he Hamana mi tha lova hi a ni!’ Estherin a ti a.

Tunah lalber chu a thinrim tak tak a. Hamana tihhlum tur thu a pe a. A hnuah lalber chuan Mordekaia chu thuneihnaah amah dawttuah a siam a. Mordekaia chuan Israel-mite chu an tihhlumna tur niah chuan an nunna tura an beih ve phalna dan a siamtir a. Tunah Mordekaia chu chutianga mi pawimawh a nih avang chuan, mi tam takin Israel-mite an tanpui a, an hmelmate laka chhandam an ni ta a.Bible-ah Estheri bu. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HETA hna thawh zawng zawng hi en teh. Israel-mite chu Jerusalem kulh siamin an hmanhlel a. A hma kum 152-a Lalber Nebukadnezzaran Jerusalem a tihchhiatin a kulh bangte a chhu chim a, khawpui kawngkate a hal a. Babulon atanga an lo haw hmasakin Israel-miten kulh bangte an siam lo.

Kum chu chen an khawpui vela kulh awm lova heta chen chu miten engtinnge ngaia i rin? Himin an inhre lo. Awlsam takin an hmelmate lo lutin anmahni an bei thei a. Mahse tunah he mi Nehemia hian, a tawpah kulh siam leh turin mipuite a tanpui a. Nehemia chu tunge a nih i hria em?

Nehemia chu Israel-mi, Mordekaia leh Estheri chenna Shushan khawpui atanga lo kal a ni a. Nehemia chuan lalber inah a thawk a, chuvangin Mordekaia leh Lalnu Estheri thian tha a ni mai thei. Mahse Bible-in Nehemia chu Estheri pasal Lal Ahasuera hna thawk a ni tih a sawi lo. A dawta lalber Artazerzia hna a thawk a ni.

Artazerzia chu Jehova biak in sak nana Jerusalem-a kalpui tur tangka zawng zawng petu lai tha kha a ni tih hrereng la. Mahse Ezran khawpui kulh bangte a siam lo va. Nehemian he hna a thawh dan hi i en ang u.

Artazerzian biak in sak that nan tangka Ezra a pek achin kum 13 a ni tawh a. Tunah chuan Nehemia chu Lalber Artazerzia no kengtu lu ber a ni a. Chu chu, lalber chu uain a pe thin a, tumahin tura hrai an tum lo tih a hre chiang tur a ni tihna a ni a. Hna pawimawh em em a ni.

E, ni khat chu Nehemia tlawh turin Nehemia unaupa Hanania leh Israel rama mi dang an lo kal a. Israelten buaina an neih chungchang leh Jerusalem kulhte a la chim reng thu an hrilh a. Chu chuan Nehemia a tilungngai em em a, Jehova hnenah a tawngtai a.

Ni khat chu lalberin Nehemia a lungngai tih a hria a, ‘Engvanginnge lungngai em ema i lan?’ tiin a zawt a. Nehemian Jerusalem chuti khawpa a la that lohzia leh a kulhte an la chim reng vang a ni tih a hrilh a. Lalber chuan: ‘Enge i duh?’ tiin a zawt a.

‘Kulhte ka siam leh theih nan Jerusalem-ah mi kaltir ta che,’ Nehemian a ti a. Lalber Artazerzia chu a ngilnei em em a. Nehemia a kal thei a ti a, tin sak nan thing a hmuh sak bawk a. Jerusalem-a Nehemia thlen hnu lawkah, a remruat chu mipui a hrilh a. Tha an ti a, ‘I sa tan ang u,’ an ti a. Israel-mite hmelmaten kulh intiang chho chu an hmuhin: ‘Kan kal chho vang a, anmahni tihlumin an in sak hna thawh kan titawp ang,’ an ti a. Mahse Nehemian chu chu a hria a, hnathawktute chu khandaih leh fei a pe a. ‘Kan hmelmate chu hlau suh u. ln unaute, in fate, in nupuite, in inte tan do rawh u,’ a ti a.

Mipuite chu an huai em em a. Chhun leh zanin an hriamhrei peih sain an dah a, an sa zel a. Tichuan ni 52 chauhvah kulh chu zawh a ni ta a. Tunah chuan mipui chuan khawpui chhungah himin an inhre ta a. Nehemia leh Ezran mipuite chu Pathian dan an zirtir a, tin mipui lah an hlim a.

Mahse thilte chu Israel-mite Babulon-a sala an tan hma ang chu a la ni lo. Mipuite chu Persia lai awp an ni a, a rawng an bawl tur a ni. Mahse Jehova chuan lalber thar a tir ang a, chu lalber chuan mipui hnenah remna a thlentir ang tih a tiam a. Chu lalber chu tunge ni? Engtinnge leiah remna a thlentir ang? Chu mi chanchin chu engmah hriat belh a nih hmain kum 450 vel a ral a. Tichuan nausen piang pawimawh ber a awm a. Mahse chu chu thawnthu dang a ni.Nehemia bung 1 aṭanga 6. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate
